Support us on Patreon!
notes.content:
Support us on Patreon!

Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/chillasart

We need your help.

First, We are just 2 people working 24/7 making games and often our work overwhelms us so we would like to outsource and expand our team in the future if possible.

Second, we want to deliver higher quality content for each game we make for the fans!

Third, you could take advantage of the Patreon tiers we put out! We will put some exclusive news of our current project(s) and even get an early steam key!



Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/chillasart

Follow us on Twitter: https://twitter.com/ChillasArt

You play as a vlogger ready to take on one of the most haunted places in Japan.
